assessment.behaviour_change: EditorComponent.ngOnInit now fetches the article and current user only when the route has a slug. /editor for a new article no longer calls GET /api/articles/undefined or runs the author-check redirect. The edit path is unchanged. ShowAuthedDirective now creates its embedded view only once, using a stored authRef. authRef is never cleared after viewContainer.clear(), so a logout followed by a login in the same session may not re-show authed content. Anonymous-only content may not re-show after a login-then-logout either.
